turns.question: We are deploying extensions for a lake export worker. Our database path is extension_rollout_r40.duckdb. Which database path should we use, and if we use an in-memory database, is its data retained when the process ends?

turns.answer: The database path is extension_rollout_r40.duckdb. No; all in-memory data is lost when the process ends.
